about.title: About Leonida Atlas
about.lead: An independent fan-made encyclopedia and atlas for Grand Theft Auto VI, built on sources rather than speculation.
about.p1: Leonida Atlas collects what is publicly known about GTA VI and organises it into connected entries: people, places, vehicles, mysteries and news. Each entry links to the sources behind it.
about.p2: Every entry carries an evidence label. Official means Rockstar said it. Strong evidence means it is clearly visible in official footage. Reported, rumour and theory mean exactly that. Debunked claims stay visible, so you can see why they're wrong.
about.p3: Positions on our map are schematic until Rockstar publishes an official map. Each marker explains whether it is confirmed or approximate and what the placement is based on.
about.p4: Seed content was drafted from cited sources with AI assistance and is awaiting human editorial review. Translations marked as machine-assisted have not yet been checked by a native speaker.
about.principle_1: Primary sources first: Rockstar's own channels outrank everything else.
about.principle_2: Several outlets repeating one rumour don't confirm it.
about.principle_3: A trailer shot is not proof of a gameplay mechanic.
about.principle_4: Unknown values stay blank. Nothing is invented to fill a table.

legal.title: Legal & disclaimer
legal.disclaimer: Leonida Atlas is an independent, non-commercial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
legal.trademarks: Grand Theft Auto, GTA, Vice City, Leonida and related names and marks are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. They are used here only to identify the game being discussed.
legal.media: Artwork on this site is original. Official trailers are embedded through YouTube's privacy-enhanced player and are not re-hosted. Uploaded images record their source, attribution and usage status.
legal.privacy: Without an account, favourites and progress stay in your browser. With an account, we store your email, preferences and tracking data to provide the service. The homepage background video and trailer stills load from YouTube in privacy-enhanced mode; other trailers play only when you choose.
legal.contact: Rights holders or anyone who spots an error can reach the editors through the contribute page. We respond to takedown requests promptly.
